g.text: Dots A–D identify the same waves in each projection.
Dashed profile lines show the period averages.
L is the full repeat distance; A = max(v) − min(v); M is the average over one period. All units are those of the displayed normalized equation.
The pulse has infinite wavelength and is shown only as a limit. At a = 13/6 the profile becomes constant, so its wavelength is also a branch limit.
